scenarios.name: Scoped registry Run-key pattern
scenarios.description: Writes a benign placeholder value beneath an HKCU SentinelForgeLab key whose suffix mirrors CurrentVersion\Run; it never touches the real Windows autostart key.

scenarios.name: Disabled scheduled task
scenarios.description: Registers one disabled, uniquely named task in the SentinelForgeLab task folder with a fixed no-op action.

scenarios.name: Benign process lineage
scenarios.description: Starts cmd.exe with a contained fixed launcher; it starts PowerShell, whose fixed child script runs `cmd.exe /d /c exit 0` and writes a marker through a managed API.

scenarios.name: Benign encoded PowerShell
scenarios.description: Runs a fixed UTF-16LE encoded command that writes one marker inside the run directory.

scenarios.name: Execution from user-writable sandbox
scenarios.description: Copies cmd.exe into the run directory and executes only `/d /c exit 0` from that copy.

scenarios.name: DNS and loopback interaction
scenarios.description: Resolves only localhost and connects only to an ephemeral loopback listener owned by the same process.

scenarios.name: Synthetic-file ransomware behavior
scenarios.description: Creates SentinelForge-marked files inside the run directory, backs them up, applies a reversible XOR transform, and renames only those generated files.

scenarios.name: Synthetic security-control modification
scenarios.description: Emits normalized JSON describing a simulated control change; no operating-system security setting is read or modified.
